_comment: Where everything lives. folders = the folders; kinds = what goes where (CLAUDE.md shows it, placement-law enforces it); concepts = which rules fire where. Edit here, then run `npx --no-install @thedecipherist/claude-packs update`.

app.purpose: PluginProcessor and PluginEditor, flat in src/: parameters, programs, session, clock, the window, bindings, actions

audio.purpose: the audio-thread code: the paraphonic voice, the ladder, MultiDrive, envelopes, mod buses (Engine, Coeffs)

params.purpose: the program record and the sysex both ways

generated.purpose: Sub37Params.h and Sub37Factory.h, written by tools/gen_headers.py from data/; never hand edited

ui.purpose: the shell adapter; after the rebuild, the native panel component and its gestures

data.purpose: params.csv (the parameter table, append only) and factory.csv (the factory bank)

panel.purpose: gen_panel.py (the panel's source), measure_overlay.py, and their output panel.json and bindings.json

resources.purpose: the PNG panel export (resources/native), until the native rebuild deletes it

design.purpose: reference pictures and their measured analysis; read-only, never read by a build step

probes.purpose: the probes and gates (*_probe.cpp, tests_main.cpp, clock_gate_test.cpp, param_reaches_audio.cpp), snapshot_main.cpp, gen_headers.py, measure scripts

docs.purpose: laws, research, manual audit, provenance, the gates, licences (logs at the root: bugs.md, todo.md, build.md)

audio-entry.what: processBlock and the audio-thread engine: voice, ladder, MultiDrive, envelopes, mod buses

processor.what: the processor: parameter registration, programs, session, clock

editor.what: the window and anything that paints: the editor, the native panel component, its gestures

patch.what: the program record and the sysex both ways

generated.what: the generated headers (Sub37Params.h, Sub37Factory.h): run tools/gen_headers.py, never hand edit

bank.what: the parameter table (append only) and the factory bank

panel.what: the panel source (gen_panel.py) and its output panel.json and bindings.json

probe.what: a probe or gate with --selftest (the house template keeps them in tools/)

reference.what: reference pictures and their measured analysis

export.what: the PNG panel export, until the native rebuild deletes it

docs.what: laws, research, provenance, the gates, licences

tools.what: scripts: gen_headers.py, measure scripts, the snapshot renderer

commands.panel-check: npm run panel:validate && npm run panel:check
commands.snapshot: Sub37Snapshot (built by the build command) writes the editor to PNG
